usage: 車 usually refers to a car or vehicle in general, depending on the context.
It can be used on its own to mean 'car', and it also appears in compound words for specific vehicles, such as 電單車 (motorcycle), 貨車 (truck), and 單車 (bicycle).
車 is a noun. When counting cars or vehicles, the usual classifier is 架, for example: 一架車.
When talking about ownership or use, you can say 我有架車 (I have a car) or 坐車 (go by car / ride in a vehicle).
For beginner vocabulary entries, it is best if most example sentences contain 車 clearly and directly.
